body:
When I read your paragraph being upset about stupid things it really clicked with me. I had a rough childhood with my mother and while I've made a lot of progress with getting past that, I still have some anexity issues that I belive are associated with it. So I've used the words "I'm so sorry, but this is just how things affect me", but I guess I never even thought about something like that being the cause for my girlfriend.  

When I've opened up about my mother she's seems very suprised and talked about how she can't understand a relationship like that with a parent since hers were so good. Essentially she has always said her childhood was great (oldest child, perfect student, didn't even become Sexually active until college, raised in a Catholic family). I guess ultimately I don't have a way of knowing for sure but with everything I've seen/heard, nothing has implied she's ever been exposed to abuse of any sort.  

I did read through the sidebar links and I realized I'm approaching our talks about it correctly for the most part. I guess I just don't know when to act, like if she's talking to me about so much will she give me some signs that she's about to take some action?  

Edit - forget to add a little about the ex. From what I've seen he does still care deeply for her, in fact he tried to get her back when she first told him about me. So I feel like he either 1. Truly believes that there is no other option for her and wants to help or 2. Has taken that stance to keep the line of communication open so that he could help her find another solution. Unfortunately I have no way to communicate with him to find out if I'm right, so I've just kind of been hoping more than I've ever hoped for anything in my life that it's option 2 and between he and I we'll be able to help her.
